parameters.content:
# The Economics of Everything — The concert
One question becomes an interactive lesson. The same pure calculation functions power the browser and this workflow.

**Setup:** Select a Header Auth credential on the webhook (header: X-Lesson-Key). Select an OpenAI credential on the model node and your TypeSafe AI API credential on Identify concert question. TypeSafe package @typesafe-ai/n8n-nodes-typesafe-ai, node schema v1; Evaluate routes intent only. Threshold 0.80 in Read intent confidence is configurable, not an accuracy guarantee. Publish, then set N8N_WEBHOOK_URL and N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the app server. See README.md.
**Privacy:** Synthetic demonstrations only. Questions are sent to OpenAI with store:false. Execution payload saving is disabled. No credentials are included in this export.
**Failure handling:** Invalid requests → correction (400). Model timeout/refusal/invalid numbers → prepared English/German lesson (200).

parameters.content:
## Revenue is not profit
At price 20: 150 guests, revenue 3,000, cost 2,250, profit 750.
At price 30: 100 guests, revenue 3,000, cost 2,000, profit 1,000.

AI selects authored bilingual paragraph IDs. It cannot write new facts. Only the shared calculator supplies numeric values. Scene actions come from an allowlist. The app rechecks calculations before displaying the response. Invented teaching assumptions, never a demand forecast.
